Candidate.description: A candidate page: `gold.candidate` and a row per cycle, newest first.
Candidate.title: Candidate

CandidateCycle.description: `gold.candidate_cycle`: a candidate's money in one cycle.
CandidateCycle.title: CandidateCycle

Committee.description: A committee page: `gold.committee` and a row per cycle, newest first.
Committee.title: Committee

CommitteeCycle.description:
`gold.committee_cycle`: a committee's money in one cycle, whom it gave most to, and who
gave most to it.
CommitteeCycle.title: CommitteeCycle

CommitteeTopRecipient.description: `gold.committee_top_recipient`: one of the 100 a committee gave most to in a cycle.
CommitteeTopRecipient.title: CommitteeTopRecipient

Contribution.description:
One counted contribution from silver `contribution` (spec §4), the contributor as
reported.
Contribution.title: Contribution

ContributionPage.description: A page of contributions, newest first; `next_cursor` fetches the next, None on the last.
ContributionPage.title: ContributionPage

DatasetPart.description:
One table's files in one cycle of a dataset snapshot, or a table's one file when it has
no cycle (`donor`, `crosswalk`).
DatasetPart.title: DatasetPart

DatasetSnapshot.description: One finished dataset snapshot, `v1/<snapshot_date>/` in the public bucket.
DatasetSnapshot.title: DatasetSnapshot

DatasetTable.description: One table of a dataset snapshot, from its `manifest.json` (spec §9).
DatasetTable.title: DatasetTable

Donor.description:
A donor page: `gold.donor`, every name, employer and address variant resolved into one
(spec §6), a row per cycle, newest first, and whom they gave most to.
Donor.title: Donor

DonorCycle.description: `gold.donor_cycle`: a donor's counted money in one cycle.
DonorCycle.title: DonorCycle

DonorTopRecipient.description:
`gold.donor_top_recipient`: one of the 100 a donor gave most to, over every cycle: a
candidate, for a gift to a committee raising for one, else the committee.
DonorTopRecipient.title: DonorTopRecipient

GiftSize.description: `gold.candidate_gift_size`: one bucket of a candidate's money in a cycle (spec §4.6).
GiftSize.title: GiftSize

IndependentExpenditure.description:
One independent expenditure from silver `independent_expenditure` (spec §4): a committee's
spending for or against a candidate, never a gift to one.
IndependentExpenditure.title: IndependentExpenditure

IndependentExpenditurePage.description:
A page of independent expenditures, newest first; `next_cursor` fetches the next, None on
the last.
IndependentExpenditurePage.title: IndependentExpenditurePage

Meta.description:
The live gold build (`gold.meta`, spec §7.1): how its donors were resolved and how well
that scored against DIME, which the methodology page prints (NEU-2056).
Meta.title: Meta

MetaCycle.description: One cycle's live build and the date of each bulk file it was built from.
MetaCycle.title: MetaCycle

OperatingExpenditure.description:
One operating expenditure from silver `operating_expenditure` (every-FEC-dollar spec §5.1): a
payment a committee itemized, the payee as reported, with the sub-items that itemize it.

Only `counted` rows add up to the committee's total_operating_expenditures: a sub-item (a card
bill's charge) is listed under its parent and never counted, nor is a memo row nothing names.
Spending, never a contribution.
OperatingExpenditure.title: OperatingExpenditure

OperatingExpenditurePage.description:
A page of a committee's operating expenditures, each with its sub-items; `next_cursor`
fetches the next, None on the last.
OperatingExpenditurePage.title: OperatingExpenditurePage

Payee.description:
A payee page: `gold.payee`, the payments committees reported to one payee key, grouped by
normalized name and never resolved (ADR-0012), a row per cycle, newest first, and who paid it
most in `cycle`. A sub-item and an in-kind outlay reach no payee (every-FEC-dollar spec
§5.4).
Payee.title: Payee

PayeeCycle.description:
`gold.payee_cycle`: what committees paid a payee in one cycle, net as filed
(every-FEC-dollar spec §5.4, §5.5).
PayeeCycle.title: PayeeCycle

PayeeTopPayer.description: `gold.payee_top_payer`: one of the 100 committees that paid a payee most in a cycle.
PayeeTopPayer.title: PayeeTopPayer

Race.description:
A race page: the race, its candidates (most money first), its top committees and its top
donors.
Race.title: Race

RaceCandidate.description: `gold.race_candidate`: a candidate in the race and their money this cycle.
RaceCandidate.title: RaceCandidate

RaceCandidateReported.description: A race candidate's headline reported figures, their `candidate_cycle` values (spec §4.4).
RaceCandidateReported.title: RaceCandidateReported

RaceSummary.description: `gold.race`: one race and its totals, summed over its candidates.
RaceSummary.title: RaceSummary

RaceTopCommittee.description: `gold.race_top_committee`: a committee among the 100 that spent most on the race.
RaceTopCommittee.title: RaceTopCommittee

RaceTopDonor.description:
`gold.race_top_donor`: a donor among the 100 who gave most to the race's candidates, their
own money left out (spec §7.1).
RaceTopDonor.title: RaceTopDonor

RaceTopDonorCandidate.description: What a race's top donor gave one of its candidates, net of refunds.
RaceTopDonorCandidate.title: RaceTopDonorCandidate

Reconciliation.description:
`gold.reconciliation`: a committee whose fundlens figure exceeds its reported one by more
than 1% on a measure (every-FEC-dollar spec §4.5, §5.6). Never a build failure: reported totals
lag amendments, and a filer's line choice is not fundlens's to fix.
Reconciliation.title: Reconciliation

ReconciliationPage.description:
A page of a cycle's reconciliation rows, the largest excess (fundlens - reported) first;
`next_cursor` fetches the next, None on the last.
ReconciliationPage.title: ReconciliationPage

ReportedTotals.description:
A committee's or candidate's reported totals for a cycle, as filed (CONTEXT.md;
every-FEC-dollar spec §4.1 to §4.4): never summed with itemized money, shown beside the
itemized total.

A measure the cycle's file lacks is None, never 0, while the rest stand: before 2008 there is
no `period_start`, `debts_owed_to`, itemized and unitemized split, `operating_expenditures` or
`federal_funds` (spec §4.7). A candidate's from 2008 are their credited committees' added up.
ReportedTotals.title: ReportedTotals

SpendingByCategory.description:
`gold.committee_spending_category`: a committee's counted operating expenditures in one
spending category in a cycle, net as filed, so possibly 0 or less (every-FEC-dollar spec
§5.3, §5.5).
SpendingByCategory.title: SpendingByCategory

TopDonor.description:
`gold.candidate_top_donor` or `gold.committee_top_donor`: a donor among the 100 who gave
most in a cycle, the candidate's own money left out (spec §7.1).
TopDonor.title: TopDonor

TopOrganization.description:
`gold.committee_top_organization`: an organization among the 100 that gave a committee
most in a cycle, its gifts grouped by organization key, never resolved (ADR-0011).
TopOrganization.title: TopOrganization

TopPayee.description:
`gold.committee_top_payee`: a payee among the 100 a committee paid most in a cycle, its
payments grouped by payee key, never resolved (ADR-0012; every-FEC-dollar spec §5.4).
TopPayee.title: TopPayee
